reason: The free pilot is fine, my child can do it since the teacher assigns it, but paying ₹249 plus ₹149 for the second one every month on top of fees, tuition and books is not something I will sign up for before I see the end-of-term re-test. I will ask my relative how it went for their child too.
objection: It is one more monthly charge for something on a phone or tablet, and I am not convinced 20 minutes of screen practice does more than the school and tuition already do.
would_change_my_mind: If the end-of-term re-test clearly shows my child's weak topics improved and the school makes it part of regular homework, I might pay the ₹999 term price for one child.
